text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen."
...The tension is palpable, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had trained day and night for this very day,
the grand stage of the sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That aside, she hasn't neglected
activities aimed at raising her publicity.
choice_data_list: (I should upload the finished 4-koma while I still can)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I updated the blog and happened
to check the analytics as well, but—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Your eyebrows are furrowed downward.
Is something the matter?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan peered in softly from the side,
then abruptly froze in place.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
............
The view count is in the single digits this month, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It had been growing relatively well until February,
but starting in March, it took an eerily sharp plunge."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that at times like this, for now,
you should press the refresh button.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Click...*)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...That's no good, is it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sure it must be some kind of error.
After all, Chan-me has been performing splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "For no one to come watch all of a sudden like this... It doesn't make any sense."
choice_data_list: I'll look into it properly once the race is over.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please go ahe—
A... tchoo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*... *achoo*!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Aye... It seems I can't really
get along with this year's spring...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'm definitely going to run in the race.
That's an absolute guarantee."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's not that I have a fever or anything. But my head feels all fluffy and dazed...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes I can't sleep even when I'm tired,
and other times I doze off when I'm not.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Curse you, spring.
choice_data_list: Let's get you to the infirmary after the race.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
N-No good. Before a race,
you're supposed to be fired up!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm just going to go soak up a little sunshine.
...*cough*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Takamatsunomiya Kinen got underway
under a somewhat ominous atmosphere.
